ruleDefinitions.name: MMC20 Lateral Movement
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects MMC20.Application Lateral Movement; specifically looks for the spawning of the parent MMC.exe with a command line of "-Embedding" as a child of svchost.exe

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Embedding.*"))
